purpose: Test the rendered v2 reviewer interface for prohibited information exposure before any real outcome collection.
source_boundary: Use only outcome-free measurement-feasibility pilot pairs that are permanently excluded from both confirmation samples.
pass_condition: All machine checks pass and an independent non-reviewer records no prohibited exposure in every required human browser check.
failure_rule: Any forbidden exposure invalidates the dry run. The exposed records, source, remediation, retest, and disposition must be documented before a new dry run can pass.
claim_boundary: A passed dry run establishes interface-blinding readiness only; it does not create an outcome label, validate a feature, or establish Re-ID performance.
